name: @hoplogic/hopjit
description: HopJIT execution engine for HopSpec v3 — structured execution runtime for LLM agents (CC / Codex reuse-mode drivers)
author: Lenx Wei

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/mcp-server.js
scripts.check:fast: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-anchor-format.mjs && node scripts/check-text-integrity.mjs && node scripts/check-process-state.mjs && node scripts/check-driver-carriers.mjs && node scripts/check-layer-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-module-arch-audit.mjs && node scripts/check-threshold-sync.mjs && node scripts/check-teaching-sync.mjs && npm run -s check:scripts-syntax
scripts.check: npm run -s check:fast && npm test && npm run -s check:audit && npm run -s check:version-lock && npm run -s check:spec-syntax && npm run -s check:e2e-assertions
scripts.check:coverage: npm run -s build && vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json-summary && node scripts/check-coverage-baseline.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:cc:delegated: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:delegated
scripts.test:e2e:cc:delegated:ds: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:delegated --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.test:e2e:codex:delegated: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:delegated
scripts.test:e2e:codex:flash: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:flash --profile deepseek-v4-flash
scripts.test:e2e:codex:demo: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:demo
scripts.test:e2e:codex:standalone: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:standalone
scripts.test:e2e:cc:parallel: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:parallel --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.test:e2e:codex:parallel: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:parallel
scripts.test:e2e:codex:standalone-parallel: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs codex:standalone-parallel
scripts.test:e2e:cc:call: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:call --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.test:e2e:cc:adaptive: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:adaptive --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.test:e2e:audit: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:anchor-audit --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.test:buildtest:mini: npm run -s build && node scripts/hopbuild-selftest.mjs --fixture scripts/fixtures/mini-skill.md --timeout-min 30
scripts.test:e2e:cc:standalone: npm run -s build && node scripts/carrier-live-e2e.mjs cc:standalone --launcher claude-ds --credential-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.fuzz:parser:cov: npm run -s build && rm -rf .coverage-fuzz && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=.coverage-fuzz node scripts/parser-fuzz.mjs && node scripts/coverage-report.mjs .coverage-fuzz --face scripts/parser-fuzz-face.json
